Interface AccessUnitVisitor

public interface AccessUnitVisitor
Visitor protocol invoked by DatasetWalker for every transport-stream event a filtered dataset produces. All methods have empty default implementations — concrete visitors override only the events they care about.

Event order:

  1. visitStreamHeader(DatasetWalker, String, String, String, List, int) once.
  2. v0.11 §5.4 prelude events (when populated): visitEncryptionAlgorithm(DatasetWalker, String), visitDatasetProvenance(DatasetWalker, List), visitSubjectMetadata(DatasetWalker, List), visitSampleMetadata(DatasetWalker, List), visitReferenceGroup(DatasetWalker, ReferenceImport) (one per reference, sorted by URI key), visitImage(DatasetWalker, MSImage), visitRamanImage(DatasetWalker, RamanImage), visitIRImage(DatasetWalker, IRImage), visitIdentificationsTable(DatasetWalker, List), visitQuantificationsTable(DatasetWalker, List).
  3. visitDatasetHeader(DatasetWalker, int, String, int, String, List, String, int) per matched dataset.
  4. visitAccessUnit(DatasetWalker, AccessUnit, int, int) per matched AU.
  5. visitEndOfDataset(DatasetWalker, int, int) per matched dataset.
  6. visitEndOfStream(DatasetWalker) once.

Cross-language equivalents:

  • Objective-C: TTIOTransportEventVisitor
  • Python: ttio.transport.walker.WalkerEvent (variant types yielded by walk_dataset)
